title: Open Homomorphisms of Global Solvably Closed Galois Groups
summary: We prove Uchida's conjecture on open homomorphisms of Galois groups. Every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields is induced by a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction. No restriction on the kernel or additional compatibility hypothesis is required.
family_title: Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups

review.reason: Proves Uchida's conjecture on open homomorphisms between solvably closed Galois groups of number fields.
